notes.title: 2024/11/07 - Version 1.0.11 Mini Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Following the game's release, we have addressed the following issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where scores were not reflected on the Extra stage leaderboard (ranking).
[*] Fixed an issue where small enemies in the Extra stage did not drop items.
[*] Fixed an issue where remaining bullets from the Stage 2 boss would hit the player and cause damage after the boss is defeated.
[*] Adjusted the volume for certain voice lines.
[*] Fixed an issue where no sound effect would play when pressing the left arrow key in the screen size change menu on the settings screen.
[/list]

[h3]The following issue was partially fixed but remains unresolved[/h3]
[list]
[*] The screen momentarily freezes when the Extra boss starts its first bullet pattern (the freeze duration should be slightly reduced).
[/list]

[h3]The following issue has not been fixed at this time[/h3]
[list]
[*] In Hard mode, there is an issue in Stage 5 where the floors of the building separate during the second phase of the mid-boss.
[/list]

notes.title: October 22,2024 Updated Demo to Version 0.0.4
notes.notes:
This demo update is based on feedback from Steam Next Fest. Similar changes have also been made to the full version prior to release.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the size of the player character to about 80%. 
[*] Displayed many enemy ships and bullets in front of the player's HP gauge.
[*] Added camera shake to represent impact when the player or boss explodes. 
[*] Changed the sound effect for the first wave of the stage 3 boss.
[/list]

notes.title: July 26, 2024 Updated Demo to Version 0.0.1
notes.notes:
A mini-update was carried out to fix bugs.

[h3]Fixed Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inconsistent shot interval bug
[*] Key bindings reset upon restart bug
[*] Key bindings not reflected in the manual bug
[*]Unable to fire bombs independently from shots bug
[*]Overlapping enemy waves when the stage 3 mid-boss is defeated early bug
[/list]

[h3]Bug Causes and Solutions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inconsistent shot interval bug
Cause: Normal shots and option shots shared the same timer, causing the 0.2-second interval of option shots and the 0.08-second interval of normal shots to mix.
Fix: Separated the intervals for normal shots and option shots, making normal shots and rear shots share the same interval.
Adjustment: Changed the interval to 0.1 seconds because the 0.08-second interval allowed for defeating enemies too quickly.

[*] Key bindings reset upon restart bug
Cause: Code that reset key bindings every time the settings screen was opened.
Fix: Removed the problematic code.
Result: Key bindings now persist after restarting the game.

[*] Key bindings not reflected in the title menu manual bug
Cause: Missing code and necessary variables to reflect key bindings in the manual when initializing settings.
Fix: Added reflection code after saving settings during initialization; included initial manual switching code in the title menu script.
Result: Key bindings reset to default are now reflected in the manual upon initialization, and the manual now displays the previous key bindings when the game is started.

[*]Unable to fire bombs independently from shots bug
Cause: The script for firing bombs was within the condition "while the shot button is pressed."
Fix: Moved the script for firing bombs to be independent of the shot button.
Result: Bombs can now be fired independently even when the shot button is not pressed.

[*]Overlapping enemy waves when the stage 3 mid-boss is defeated early bug
Cause: Enemies from Wave 1 continued to fire bullets even after Wave 2 had started.
Fix: Added code to clear all enemies and bullets on the screen before Wave 2 begins.
Result: The two waves no longer overlap.
[/list]

That's all for the update.
The change in shot interval may affect scores, but not significantly enough to alter high scores or rankings. The demo ranking will continue without resetting.

[h3]Update Method[/h3]
If your PC and Steam client are running, the update may not be applied. Also, pressing the ✖ icon in the upper right of the Steam client does not fully close Steam. To apply the update, open Task Manager with Ctrl+Alt+Delete, close Steam, and then restart it. The update will begin automatically.

notes.title: July 24: Demo Release
notes.notes:
Although the demo (DEMO) is already listed in the search results, it cannot be downloaded until the demo app is actually released.

On July 24 (Wednesday), a download button will be displayed on the product store page for Ad SHOOt:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954360/Ad_SHOOt/

Of the five voice actors, you can hear parts of the voices of four (Kyōhei Natsume, Haruki Asada, Yūki Amezawa, Daisuke Hirakawa/) in the demo, excluding Masahiro Yamanaka.

The bosses appearing in stages 1-3 will have further appearances, so fans of the characters and their voice actors should look forward to the full version, which is scheduled for release around November 5.

The Extra Stage, featuring the boss voiced by Mr.Yamanaka, will be available once you complete the main 6 stages of the full version.
Even in Easy mode, you can unlock it by clearing the 6 stages with any number of continues. For those new to shooting games, please try the demo and get the hang of it to clear the 6 stages in the full version.

You can add the full version to your wishlist on the product store now! Wishlist registration is free (Steam account required)!
